behavior.text: Sleep homeostasis: the dorsal fan-shaped body (dFB) neurons accumulate sleep pressure during wakefulness and discharge it during sleep, gating arousal through fan-shaped body columnar, delta, and extrinsic output circuits of the central complex.
behavior.basis: dFB as the sleep homeostat is textbook Drosophila (Donlea et al 2011; Ueno et al 2012); edges below are the resolved API walk, stated as measured wiring

honest_note: Hop-0 grouped /query_connectivity died server-side (IncompleteRead, ~1.4MB truncated); hop-1 weights come from the named DownstreamClassConnectivity query (50 rows). Hop-1 skips ontology parents, transmitter buckets, and self as documented in the builder docstring; duplicated tiers represented by most specific member. One hop-2 pick ('small field neuron' FBbt_00003633) was the ontology parent of the hop-1 node 'small field neuron of the central complex' — its edges were redirected to the specific child rather than adding the parent as a node. The other hop-2 node ('adult central complex neuron' FBbt_00049819) is a broad parent bucket kept as the top non-duplicate candidate — real edges, broad label. CIRCUIT VS HOMEOSTAT: every edge here is REAL measured wiring of dFB's downstream command chain within the central complex. The HOMEOSTAT DYNAMICS — pressure accumulation rate, discharge kinetics, arousal gating — are the genuinely unmapped frontier; no API holds them, and nothing here models them.
